title: Metagenomic sequencing protocol for respiratory virus detection from SARS-CoV-2 tests
author: Emmanuela Jules
materials: Linear Acrylamide (LA) Water - make this first

RNA Extraction from nasopharyngeal swabs used in SARS-CoV-2 rapid antigen testing This extraction protocol uses the Qiagen EZ1 Advanced XL Instrument and Qiagen EZ1 DSP Virus Kit: https://www.qiagen.com/us/products/diagnostics-and-clinical-research/solutions-for-laboratory-developed-tests/ez1-dsp-virus-kit-na Add Linear Acrylamide to the AVE Buffer, multiplying each volume of reagent by the number of samples and overage volume of 15%: Extraction Protocol: A 1 1. Label 2.0 mL unskirted conical-bottom sample tubes. Add 250 uL of Qiagen Buffer G2 Digestion buffer to each tube. 2 2. Remove the swab from the BinaxNow cartridge. Swirl it in buffer for 10 secs. Squeeze the swab on the side of the sample tube while removing the swab from the buffer. 3 3. Wipe the outside of the instrument with 70% EtOH, and insert the EZ1 Advanced XL DSP Virus Card into the card slot. 4 4. Turn on instrument and run the cleaning operation. Clean the piercing unit with 70% EtOH. 5 5. Press START to start work table setup. Select 200 uL sample and 60 uL elution volumes. 6 6. Insert loaded cartridge rack into the EZ1 instrument: a. Invert reagent cartridges (RCV) 3 times and tap the cartridges to deposit the reagents. Slide 1 cartridge rack per sample into the cartridge rack until it clicks into place. b. Load empty 2.0 mL unskirted conical bottom tubes into the heating system slot of each cartridge. 7 7. Insert loaded tip rack into the EZ1 instrument: a. First row: 1.5 mL conical-bottom elution tubes b. Second row: Tip holders containing tips c. Third row: 1.5 mL conical bottom tube containing linear acrylamide and AVE buffer solution d. Fourth row: Samples from Step 2 8 8. Close the instrument door and press START to run EZ1 Virus Protocol. 9 9. Aliquot 30uL from the elution tubes into a new 1.5 mL conical bottom tube.

steps.title: Prepare Carrier RNA Depletion Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare reagent mixes for carrier RNA depletion (optional if samples were extracted with carrier RNA instead of linear acrylamide). Volumes provided are for up to 40 RNA samples including controls; increase proportionately for more samples.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 1 M Tris-HCl pH 7.5 (1000 µl).
Prepare Hybridization Mix, multiplying each volume of reagent by the number of samples plus a 15% overage.

steps.title: Prepare Tagmentation and PCR Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the following reagent mixes, multiplying each volume by the number of samples plus a 15% overage.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Tagmentation Reagent Mix on an ice block.
Prepare an aliquot of NT buffer at room temperature.
Prepare a mix of Nextera PCR Reagent Mix and water.
Prepare the RNase Mix and distribute into a strip tube.
Prepare the DNAse Mix.

steps.title: Perform Random Priming and cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Execute the cDNA synthesis process using the following reagent preparations, multiplying each volume by the number of samples plus a 15% overage.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot random primers, vortex, and spin.
Prepare First Strand Synthesis Mix, vortex, and spin.
Prepare Second Strand Synthesis Mix, vortex, and spin.

steps.title: Prepare DNAClean Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the following reagents for the DNA SPRI procedure:

substeps.instruction: DNA SPRI Beads: 153 µl per sample.
71% EtOH: 7.1 mL 100% EtOH + 2.9 mL nuclease-free water.
EDTA: 5 µl per sample.
Elution Buffer (EB): 1:100 ratio of Tris pH 8 to nuclease free water.

steps.title: Perform DNA SPRI Procedure
steps.instruction: Clean the DNA samples using the SPRI bead protocol.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.7X SPRI Beads; mix well for 10 minutes (mix halfway through).
Place on magnet for 5 minutes.
Remove buffer.
Perform 71% EtOH wash (150 µl) for 1 minute.
Remove EtOH.
Perform a second 71% EtOH wash (150 µl) for 1 minute.
Remove EtOH and dry sample for 10 minutes until beads look matte rather than glossy.
Resuspend beads in EB; mix well for 10 minutes (mix halfway through).
Place on magnet for 5 minutes.
Transfer 10 µl eluent to a screw cap tube and store at -20°C.

steps.title: Quantify Libraries via KAPA qPCR
steps.instruction: Quantify the libraries using KAPA qPCR standards and reaction mix.

substeps.instruction: Thaw KAPA reaction mix and qPCR standards.
Prepare KAPA qPCR mix in a 1.5 ml tube on ice, multiplying volumes by the number of samples (including 6 standards and 1 negative control) plus 15% overage; vortex and spin.
Add 12.4 µl of mix to each well of an optical 96-well plate on ice.
Add 8 µl of NTC and 6 standards to appropriate wells.
Dilute libraries: make a 1:100 dilution with EB, then a further 1:100 dilution with water (final 1:10,000 dilution).
Add 8 µl of the final 1:10,000 dilution of each sample to appropriate wells.
Seal plate, gently vortex, spin down, and run under cycling conditions.

steps.title: Normalize and Pool Libraries
steps.instruction: Normalize libraries to equimolar concentrations and perform a final cleanup.

substeps.instruction: Note concentrations in nM and normalize each sample to the desired concentration (typically 4 nM).
Pool libraries to equimolar concentrations; if total volume is too low, bring up to 50 µl with EB.
Warm SPRI beads to room temperature for 30 minutes.
Perform a 0.8X SPRI cleanup.
Quantify the clean pool using KAPA qPCR (following the dilution and quantification steps previously described).
Prepare the pool for sequencing according to the manufacturer's instructions for the specific sequencing kit.
